verdict.rationale: Fivetran provides a documented Connector SDK for building custom connectors in Python, deployed as first-class extensions (not forks), with a setup guide, GitHub repo, and even AI coding agent plugins/skills for building connectors via natural language prompts. This directly supports the described workflow for long-tail APIs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of building a specific long-tail connector end-to-end and more detail on low-code (non-SDK) builder options.
